title: Retail and service establishments
previewText: The underlying M1 District use regulations shall be modified such that uses listed under Use Group VI with a size limitation, as denoted with an “S” in the Use Group tables set forth in Section 42-16 (Use Group VI – Retail and Services), inclusive, shall be permitted without a size limitation.
